_provenance.method: Extracted by scripts/extract-nasr-airport.ts MHT KMHT. ILS rows with ARPT_ID == MHT; navaids named in kmht-procedures.json navaids_referenced; fixes = every 5-letter fix named in fixes_and_roles of an instrument approach in that file (each also checked against NASR FIX_BASE and, in charted_on, FIX_CHRT).

primary_navaid.name: MANCHESTER
primary_navaid.location_note: NASR NAV_BASE row MHT type DME (114.4 MHz, channel 91X), 42.86852991 N 71.3695345 W: about 4.8 NM from the ARP on true bearing about 143 (southeast) (computed from the NASR coordinates, not an FAA-published figure). There is NO VOR/VORTAC at MHT; the nearest VOR/DMEs used by the plates are CON (Concord) and GDM (Gardner).

ils_localizers.note: Three ILS exist: runway 6 (I-MJE 109.95, localizer + glideslope, no DME), runway 17 (I-MNA 109.1, LOC/DME channel 28X) and runway 35 (I-MHT 109.1, LOC/DME channel 28X, NASR category III). Runway 17 and 35 share DME channel 28X and frequency 109.1 (interlocked reciprocal pair; NASR remark "DME ALSO SERVES RY 35 / 17"). Runway 24 has no ILS or LOC (RNAV (GPS) only). NASR lists no DME row for runway 6.

unverified: Fix roles are human-read from plate images; verify against the PDFs before safety-critical use. Fixes on the RNP, SA CAT I and CAT II/III charts are not transcribed (OLDMN and OFTHE appear only on RNAV (RNP) Z RWY 35).
The MHT DME is "OPERATIONAL IFR"; the DME elements of the ILS are "OPERATIONAL RESTRICTED" in NASR ILS_DME.csv.
VOR/DME CON and GDM status and variation are as printed in NAV_BASE (variation epochs 1980 and 1970).
